title: Catching Zombkolaps
author: Discoveries Against Turning (DAT) Foundation
pages: Broadly speaking, the DAT Foundation believes that there are three ways for Zombkolaps. All involve physical contact.
Firstly, Zombkolaps can spread through a bite by an infected individual. All bites should seek immediate medical attention. If this is not possible, then self isolate to protect others around you.
The second way is from parent to child. An infected individual that births a child will often pass this down to them. This sad situation makes checking children a priority.
Finally, Zombkolaps can spread through consuming rotten flesh. While this is rare, there are reports of this occurring. Do not eat rotten flesh.

Importantly, Zombkolaps can not spread through:
Air
Water
Books
Do not forget these contents and stay safe out there!
